tree: What is an IVR call menu?
An IVR (interactive voice response) answers the call with a greeting and offers options. Callers press a key or say what they need, and the call goes to the right team, voicemail or booking line.
Every call lands on the same person, who has to transfer it by hand.
Callers choose an option and reach the right team on the first try.
IVR software guides every caller to the right option.
Set up your call menu, define the options and route calls to teams, phone numbers or AI agents — all from a simple visual builder.
Manage your call menus and routing.
